opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers toward a paid pathway into Bitcoin-related pool participation. It tells them to register through a link under the video, then states that they will not be able to see the full information until paying a $99 membership fee. After that payment, viewers are offered a workspace where they can purchase pools with Bitcoin Cash. This combines a required cryptocurrency payment, access conditioned on membership, and an invitation to participate in mining-related pools, presenting the service as a way to pursue Bitcoin returns rather than merely describing or criticizing it.
